flags: PRIVATE GATE (passes): site $44 + the park's 4% 'Processing Fee' $1.76 = $45.76 a night before Campspot's $3 booking fee ($48.76 all-in before tax), from the 2026-10-13 Campspot read. I could not re-read today: Campspot returns no inventory for May-July 2027 yet. Camper reports (RV Life): $44 7/2026, $48 6/2026, $45/$50/$45 2024. No gateway within 40 km (Wisconsin Dells 168 km). Under the builder rule that stores 'any fee the park charges every night', the stored $44 could arguably be $45.76; either way under $50.

REVIEWS (pass): Google 4.4/104; RV Life 4.5 stars; Campspot 4.0/13. Complaints read: Google 2/5 'a year ago': 'the bathrooms were horrible not cleaned once for the weekend no toliet paper and was very nasty'; RV Life 7/2024: 'Nobody there to check in mid week, hard to get a hold of by phone' and 'we arrived on a Wednesday to find the office closed'. Not a drop in my reading.

LONG-STAY (passes): Tripadvisor (shown on Google): 'sites for permanents and occasional visitors as well. There are several hundred campsites'; Campspot terms speak of 'Registered Seasonal park guests'; an RV Life camper stayed 'a little over a month' for work. Test 2: one night sold online on Campspot. Test 3: no RV minimum seen (the 2-night minimum on 2026-10-20 applied to the cabin and rental campers only). Test 4: 55 RV + 7 tent sites sold nightly of 262 pads on the park map = ~24%. Test 5: no homes or lots for sale seen. Mostly seasonal, but not borderline.

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview kept; lakefront lead): Quarry Lake (stored 18 acres; ~400 x 300 m on imagery, so well over the 5-acre line) sits in the park's south half; the Turkey River (~45-50 m wide) bounds the east side behind a road and a tree belt. Imagery shows a packed row of ~30 RVs along the lake's south-east shore on open grass ~10-20 m from the water with the river-side road behind them, plus rows on the west shore and the loops near the lodge and beach. Which of those are the 55 nightly sites the operator does not say, and the Campspot map does not mark nightly vs seasonal. Camper evidence for nightly sites: 7/2026 (site 961, $44) 'We had a nice site that backed onto the lake'; 6/2024 pull-through 120 'were able to see the lake'. If AWH accepts a camper's 'backed onto the lake', some nightly sites are lakefront; on operator evidence alone, lakeview stays.
